name: bleavit-foresight
description: Draft forecast questions, clarify key terms, identify authoritative resolution sources, and define resolution criteria.

interface.longDescription: Built for forecasters and researchers, Bleavit Foresight guides users through an interactive, approval-based workflow. It drafts concise questions from new events, forecasts, or outcomes; clarifies ambiguous terms; identifies independent, authoritative resolution sources; and develops source-grounded resolution criteria. Users can add neutral background information and, with explicit opt-in, a concise timeline of relevant recent news. A semantic-risk review can examine wording, exceptions, and resolution rules. The plugin supports research and specification drafting; it does not predict outcomes.
